species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 44°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 26–100 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 44°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 44°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 14–34 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
